new_scholarship.description: The Ulam NAWA Programme is an institutional programme of the Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange that lets Polish higher education and research institutions employ outstanding scientists from abroad for 6 to 24 months, with projects starting between 1 February and 1 December 2027. The funding covers remuneration of the invited Principal Investigator up to PLN 17,000 per month including employer costs and an allowance of up to PLN 1,200 per month for the Inviting Person, with a maximum of PLN 436,800 per project. Invited scientists conduct research, postdoctoral training, publication work and grant preparation, with teaching as a complementary activity, and the programme is open to all disciplines. Applications are submitted by the Polish host institution in English through NAWA's ICT system; the 2026 call closed on 15 May 2026 at 3:00 p.m. CET with results due by 30 November 2026.

new_scholarship.description: The Bekker NAWA Programme supports the international mobility of PhD students, scientists and academic teachers from Polish scientific and academic units by funding research fellowships of 3 to 24 months at recognised research centres abroad. It covers the scholarship holder's living expenses during the stay together with a mobility allowance, and the amount may be increased for a spouse, underage children, or an assistant with a severe or moderate disability. The programme is open to all scientific and artistic disciplines with no restriction on host countries, and can serve as a postdoctoral fellowship for young scientists or as part of doctoral education for PhD students. It funds research fellowships of 3 to 24 months in recognised research centres worldwide, open to all scientific disciplines and to artistic disciplines, with no restriction on the host country.
